face.flavorText: Originally devoted to snuffing out the Titans' influence, Shadowflame has twisted Fyrakk's mind into an abyss of malice. His Dreamrender now only hungers for a world of embers.

policy.budget: Sequential actual CASTs use printed cost, all-class collectible Fire pool with remaining-cost ceiling, replacement; no hand cost/payment, each attempt spends its printed amount.
policy.targeting: Existing ENEMY_IF_AVAILABLE policy; structural target rules, no-target failures and untargeted bodies remain ordinary CAST behavior.
policy.source: Accepted sequence continues after minion death, silence, control change or transformation; a terminal game interrupts normally.
policy.immunity: Native single-school incoming spell damage prevention and enemy manual target protection; combat, other schools, own targeting and non-damage destruction retain ordinary rules.
policy.calibration: Exact budget sampling/sequence, no-target/exhaustion and source-lifetime policies await CN; 34.0.2 supports 10-cost/15 mana and original source matches.
